# Aaryan Kumar Tiwari

Canonical profile: https://aaaryan.space/story

Aaryan Kumar Tiwari is an Indian founder and software developer based in Panaji, Goa. He is the founder of Blendable3D, works alongside Picobooth LLP, and is pursuing a BCA (Hons) at Parul University from 2025 to 2029.

His public work spans accessible software, artificial intelligence, language models, compiler design, systems programming, and full-stack product engineering.

Verified profiles:
- GitHub: https://github.com/NoticedXAaryan
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/noticedxaaryan

Featured public projects:
- SamjhoAI: sign-language-enabled inclusive collaboration
- Rusty: an experimental programming language and compiler
- Calmant: an AI personal executive assistant
- NanoLLM: a small language model built from scratch
- JanSevak: multilingual help for Indian government services
- Ozone: a compiler built in Rust
